How it works

  1. 1

    Choose a programme

    Browse the catalogue and pick the standard your team needs — for one learner or for a whole site.

  2. 2

    Get an invoice

    Check out and a VAT invoice is issued immediately. Pay by EFT and upload your proof of payment.

  3. 3

    Learn at your pace

    We activate your seats. Work through video, written and downloadable material, ticking off lessons as you go.

  4. 4

    Earn your certificate

    Pass each course assessment and download a verifiable certificate of completion.
